loop_primitives.note: Data-generation solver (paper) used an orchestrator+websurfer multi-agent pipeline, not the shipped agent.

multi_agent_topology.note: FaraGen data pipeline (paper Sec. 2.2) is multi-agent, but the shipped agent is a single model.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: **Fara-Agent Class** - Reference implementation for running the Fara models

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Fara1.5 can ask for missing information, flag ambiguous tasks, and pause for approval before irreversible actions
human_in_loop.note: Model-initiated pause at critical points; Magentic-UI adds user prompts at critical points.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: given a screenshot of the browser and the conversation history

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Each retry starts with a fresh browser session, with no retained state

state_persistence.note: save_state/load_state hooks default to no-op pass.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the **Universal Verifier** (`MMRubricAgent`) is the official judge
self_verification.note: Judge is part of the eval pipeline, not the run loop.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Complete yet incorrect trajectories are never retried
retry_policy.note: Up to 5 retries only on environment errors.

rollback.evidence_quote: Each retry starts with a fresh browser session, with no retained state

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Each trajectory is capped at a maximum of 100 actions across all online benchmarks.
termination_condition.note: terminate() tool call is the model-declared stop; --max_rounds 100 is the step cap.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Each trajectory is capped at a maximum of 100 actions across all online benchmarks.
cost_controls.note: Only a step budget; no token/cost cap or caching found in evidence.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Browser errors (connection drops, page timeouts) are handled robustly

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Each task-solving session runs in an isolated process that encapsulates a headless Playwright instance.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: The primary responsibility of the WebSurfer is to interact directly with the browser via Playwright
filesystem_access.note: Actions are browser-only; no filesystem tool exposed.

permission_model.evidence_quote: The predicted action is then executed in the browser environment.
permission_model.note: Critical-point stopping is model behaviour, not a harness authorisation gate.

tracing.evidence_quote: Runs save a full trajectory — per-step screenshots and a `data_point.json` (task, actions, observations, and outcome)

replayability.note: Trajectories are recorded and re-scorable via verify_trajectories.py; live websites prevent exact replay.

guardrails.evidence_quote: safety measures include refusing harmful tasks based on responsible AI policies, prompting users at critical interaction points
guardrails.note: Enforced by model training rather than harness code.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Fara1.5** is a family of native Computer Use Agents (CUAs)

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Abstract Web Agent Interface** - Allows integration of any model from any source into the evaluation environment
model_agnostic.note: OpenAI-compatible endpoint config; default is the Fara weights.
